BrochureContent.Content:
Nestled within the mature and highly regarded Shrewsbury Lawn development, overlooking the verdant expanses of Kilbogget Park, No. 90 is an exceptional detached family residence that perfectly balances timeless character with contemporary comfort. Extending to approximately 186 sq.m (2,002 sq.ft.), this substantial home has been lovingly maintained and thoughtfully upgraded, offering a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey family home in one of South Dublin's most sought-after residential settings.

Approached through attractive gates and framed by mature landscaping, the property immediately conveys a sense of privacy and tranquillity. The distinctive stone-clad façade, generous proportions and established setting create an impressive first impression, while the beautifully maintained gardens and ample off-street parking further enhance its appeal.

Stepping inside, one is welcomed by a bright and inviting interior where exceptional natural light floods the accommodation throughout the day. The well-balanced layout has been designed with modern family living in mind, offering an excellent combination of formal and informal reception spaces. The principal living room is a particularly impressive space, centred around a striking natural stone fireplace that serves as a wonderful focal point. Large picture windows frame views of the front garden and allow sunlight to stream into the room, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Beyond, the open-plan living and dining areas provide the perfect setting for both everyday family life and entertaining on a larger scale. Full-height glazing and large timber-framed windows create a seamless connection between the interior and the surrounding gardens, while the elegant contemporary décor enhances the sense of light and space throughout.

At the heart of the home lies the bespoke Newcastle Design kitchen, a timeless walnut shaker-style installation complemented by elegant quartz worktops crafted by Auldstone Crafts Ltd of Gorey. Beautifully designed and exceptionally practical, the kitchen offers extensive storage, high-quality integrated appliances and a central island, making it a true focal point for family gatherings. A spacious breakfast area further enhances the room's versatility and provides an ideal setting for informal dining.

The accommodation is both generous and flexible. In addition to the principal reception rooms, there is a comfortable family room, a study ideally suited to remote working, a utility room and a wonderful conservatory that serves as a year-round garden retreat. Bathed in natural light through its glazed roof and walls, the conservatory enjoys uninterrupted views over the mature rear garden and provides a peaceful space to relax regardless of the season.

The bedroom accommodation is thoughtfully arranged and well-proportioned. The principal bedroom enjoys a peaceful outlook over the surrounding gardens and offers an abundance of natural light, while the additional bedrooms provide comfortable accommodation for a growing family. A ground-floor bedroom adds further flexibility and may be used for guests, multigenerational living, or as an additional home office if desired.
Particular attention has been given to the bathrooms, both of which were completely redesigned and installed by The Bath House, Monkstown in 2023. Finished to an exceptional standard, they feature luxurious contemporary fittings, recessed Vanquish mirror cabinets, underfloor heating and elegant walk-in shower areas. The upstairs shower room is further enhanced by the inclusion of a premium Geberit shower toilet, reflecting the quality of finish found throughout the property.

Outside, the gardens are a particular feature. Surrounded by mature hedging that provides outstanding privacy and shelter, the rear garden offers a peaceful outdoor sanctuary with well-maintained lawns, established planting and a secluded seating area ideal for al fresco dining and entertaining. The mature landscaping creates a wonderful sense of seclusion while requiring relatively modest maintenance.

The location is simply outstanding. Shrewsbury Lawn enjoys a quiet and family-friendly setting just moments from Cabinteely Village and its excellent selection of shops, cafés and restaurants. Some of South County Dublin's most respected primary and secondary schools are within easy reach, including Loreto Foxrock, St. Brigid's, Cluny, Holy Child Killiney, CBC Monkstown, Clonkeen College and Cabinteely Community School. Recreational amenities are equally impressive, with Kilbogget Park, Cabinteely Park, Killiney Hill, Leopardstown Racecourse and numerous golf and sailing clubs all nearby.

For commuters, the convenience is exceptional. The N11, M50 and Cherrywood LUAS station are all easily accessible, while a range of Dublin Bus services and the Aircoach provide excellent public transport connections to the city centre, Dublin Airport and beyond. Combining generous family accommodation, high-quality finishes, recent upgrades and a prestigious South Dublin address, No. 90 Shrewsbury Lawn represents a rare opportunity to secure a distinguished detached residence in a location that continues to be among the most desirable in the capital. A home of enduring appeal, it offers the perfect setting for modern family life in a mature and established neighbourhood.
